name: Show of Force
desc: The "functional" Planetkiller Launch Site has emboldened the populace of $market. Officials across the sector eager to avoid causing a diplomatic incident are fast-tracking all shipments to and from $market. Pragmatic individuals living under other factions are actively pursuing immigration.

desc: The Alpha-level AI core currently assigned to internal and external propaganda regarding the "functional" Planetkiller Launch Site has emboldened the populace of $market. Officials across the sector eager to avoid causing a diplomatic incident are fast-tracking all shipments to and from $market. name: Failed Cryosanctum
desc: An enormous tomb-like vault built to store the DOMINT personnel who managed this blacksite in the event of enacting network failure protocol. Unfortunately for those inside, the many-times redundant support infrastructure emblematic of cryosanctums has since been dismantled and repurposed by the local drones, killing all occupants. Now rotted to dust over countless cycles, they aren't even suitable for organ harvesting operations.

name: Volturnian Lobster Pens
desc: A mix of several Old Earth species and a little imagination produced this creature which now grows wild in the crushing depths of $market's sea-floor. The flavor is said to be exceptional, the secret ingredient was crime.
